collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_reset_epoch36 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_c_reset_epoch  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Unbound reset padding prototype: two face registers plus static release-epoch counter, no long delay line. RELEASE2 is plain two-register forward payload. Assertion cancels earlier than old long chain; parent reset contract/replay required. Outline is minimum power/clock candidate, sparse utilisation explicitly pending measurement.
